title: Dover Operating Companies to Present Latest Technologies and Solutions at Premier Convenience and Fuel Retail Trade Show
summary: /PRNewswire/ -- Dover (NYSE: DOV) today announced that several of its operating companies will showcase innovative technologies and solutions at the upcoming...
body_markdown:
DOWNERS GROVE, Ill.


, Sept. 30, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Dover](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=3029131000&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dovercorporation.com%2F&a=Dover) (NYSE:DOV ) today announced that several of its operating companies will showcase innovative technologies and solutions at the upcoming National Association of Convenience Stores Trade Show ("NACS Show") and Petroleum Equipment Institute Convention ("PEI Convention") – the leading convenience retail and fueling industry events in the United States – from October 6-9, 2026, in Las Vegas, NV.


Convenience retail is a large and growing industry serving 160 million customers daily, and it is a key market for Dover with multiple avenues for expansion across clean energy, retail fueling, digital software solutions, foodservice, refrigeration and vehicle wash.


At the 2026 NACS Show and PEI Convention, Dover's operating companies will highlight technologies, services and innovations designed to help convenience store operators and retailers enhance efficiency, deliver better customer experiences and adapt to the evolving needs of the industry. Participating Dover operating companies include:


**Dover Food Retail (DFR):**[DFR](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=3885671783&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hillphoenix.com%2Fcompany%2Fdover-food-retail%2F&a=DFR) partners with customers seeking to create unique food experiences utilizing sustainable refrigeration technologies and displays. Employing the capabilities of its core brands, Anthony® and Hillphoenix®, DFR provides insight and a comprehensive portfolio of innovative solutions that enable customers to sell more food, more profitably and more responsibly. DFR will showcase several innovations in booth C5375 that elevate applications specifically for convenience stores and the small format food retail market:


- [Infinity® 90 All-Glass Walk-In Cooler Doors](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=2908575641&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.anthonyintl.com%2Fwhy-infinity-max%2F&a=Infinity%C2%AE%C2%A090+All-Glass+Walk-In+Cooler+Doors) by Anthony are engineered for both cooler and freezer applications, featuring a contemporary look with an ultra-slim border that maximizes product visibility and encourages sales. Beyond its striking aesthetic, the door combines triple-pane Low-E glass, Optimax 7 LED lighting, and advanced door air shield anti-condensate technology to deliver up to 57% energy savings on cooler doors and 24% on freezer doors compared to traditional models, while ensuring maximum thermal performance and durability. Behind the glass doors, the new gravity flow shelving and mini roller mats enhance the shopping and merchandising experience and are easy for convenience store operators to use.


- [Second Nature® refrigeration](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=3748462245&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hillphoenix.com%2Fsecond-nature-r290%2F&a=Second+Nature%C2%AE%C2%A0refrigeration) by Hillphoenix is expanding its industry-leading natural refrigeration portfolio with eco-friendly solutions engineered for small footprints and high-volume retail. The PT multi-deck merchandiser with prep top and the QC bottom mount 5-deck merchandiser highlight the growing R-290 self-contained display case line, providing convenience store operators with plug-and-play flexibility. For operators seeking centralized efficiency, Hillphoenix is also introducing the Advansor® FlexOne, its newest compact transcritical CO2 condensing unit, designed for high-ambient operation and efficient natural refrigeration within a minimal physical footprint. This solution enables convenience stores to remodel existing locations and build new ones using regulatory-ready natural refrigerants.


- [Parts Programs](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=2334180575&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hillphoenix.com%2Fdisplay-case-and-refrigeration-systems-oem-genuine-parts%2F&a=Parts+Programs) by Hillphoenix Parts+ and Anthony Parts+ offer streamlined, reliable solutions designed to minimize downtime and maximize equipment longevity across systems and display cases. Retailers benefit from expert-led refresh services, customizable distribution programs, and equipment-specific kits with durable, genuine OEM replacement components. Through customer-focused warehousing and the enhanced Anthony Parts+ e-commerce platform, retailers can simplify ordering of complete replacement doors or individual components using order numbers from door labels, mobile-friendly reorder templates, and flexible payment options. Together, Hillphoenix and Anthony deliver fast, reliable fulfillment and end-to-end support to keep retail refrigeration operating at peak performance.


**Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS):**[DFS](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=639407969&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.doverfuelingsolutions.com%2Fna%2Fen%2Fnews-and-events%2Fevents%2F2026-nacs-expo.html&a=%C2%A0DFS) , a leading global provider of advanced customer-focused technologies, services, and solutions for the fuel and convenience retail industries, will showcase a range of technologies designed to support greater efficiency, visibility, and control across the retail site, including:


- [DFS Anthem UX®](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=1669897466&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.doverfuelingsolutions.com%2Fna%2Fen%2Fproducts-and-solutions%2Fdfs-anthem-ux.html&a=DFS+Anthem+UX%C2%AE) and[DX Promote®](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=694853283&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.doverfuelingsolutions.com%2Fna%2Fen%2Fproducts-and-solutions%2Fdfs-anthem-ux%2Fdx-promote.html&a=DX+Promote%C2%AE) : Anthem UX helps retailers modernize the fueling experience while extending the value of each customer visit. Through DX Promote, retailers can deliver timely offers and dynamic media at the pump to create new revenue opportunities and encourage in-store purchases.


- [SiteIQ™](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=3486928730&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.site-iq.com%2F&a=SiteIQ%E2%84%A2) : Provides operators with a real-time view of site health and turns forecourt data into actionable insights. Proactive alerts, remote diagnostics, and automated workflows can help retailers quickly address dispenser or payment issues, often without dispatching a technician.


- [Bulloch POS™](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=1253753077&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.doverfuelingsolutions.com%2Fna%2Fen%2Fproducts-and-solutions%2Fsecure-payment%2FBulloch-POS%2Fbulloch-pos-google-ads-ppc-campaign.html%3Fgad_source%3D1%26gad_campaignid%3D23755057810%26gbraid%3D0AAAAABeiwudDw6Wwny71OldxKmXUj6fy7%26gclid%3DEAIaIQobChMIwqqYoqnVlgMVqzcIBR0BWy_8EAAYASAAEgKduPD_BwE&a=Bulloch+POS%E2%84%A2) : Built specifically for fuel and convenience retailers, Bulloch POS brings point of sale, payments, and forecourt control together in one system and is designed to scale from a single location to hundreds of sites.


- [DX Fleet®](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=1462505964&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.doverfuelingsolutions.com%2Fna%2Fen%2Fproducts-and-solutions%2Ffleet-fuel-management-systems%2Fdx-fleet.html&a=DX+Fleet%C2%AE) : A cloud-based fuel management solution that enables fleet owners and operators to manage fueling operations remotely. Real-time data and centralized dashboards provide visibility across sites, while the[DX Fleet mobile app](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=1399073733&u=https%3A%2F%2Fapps.apple.com%2Fus%2Fapp%2Fdx-fleet%2Fid6499572188&a=DX+Fleet+mobile+app) can be used to authorize fueling.


- [ClearView™](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=1002417106&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.doverfuelingsolutions.com%2Fna%2Fen%2Fproducts-and-solutions%2Fasset-management%2FClearView.html&a=ClearView%E2%84%A2) : Provides real-time insight into wetstock operations and remote monitoring of ATGs across sites, helping retailers identify fuel loss or equipment issues before they become significant problems.


- [Wayne PWR™ DC fast chargers](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=1721944263&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.doverfuelingsolutions.com%2Fna%2Fen%2Fproducts-and-solutions%2Fev-charging%2Fwayne-pwr.html&a=Wayne+PWR%E2%84%A2+DC+fast+chargers) : Offers flexible EV charging with power configurations up to 640 kW. Available in single or dual-cable configurations, Wayne PWR supports CCS1 and NACS connector options, and its remote monitoring capabilities help identify issues early and reduce downtime.


**OPW Retail Fueling (OPW RF):**[OPW RF](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=2881961142&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.opwglobal.com%2Fopw-retail-fueling&a=OPW+RF) , a global leader in fluid-handling solutions, will showcase innovation in fueling equipment design with a robust collection of advanced products, including:


- Pre-Plumbed Commercial DSE Dispenser Sump: The newest member of the OPW "E-Series" family is a factory-assembled and tested commercial DSE Dispenser Sump with all entry fittings, stabilizer bars, shear valves, riser pipes, and tees or elbows. It utilizes the versatile DSE base made with Advanced Composite Technology to produce consistent wall thickness and smooth, watertight walls. The smooth sides bond effectively to entry fittings to help prevent leaks, and the entire system is highly site-configurable to match specific piping layouts for commercial dispenser applications.


- Quick Bolt-On Coupling (QBC): This innovative fitting creates a fluid-tight seal using an embedded gasket that clamps easily to a flat face, significantly reducing the need for NPT threaded connections. The face-to-face metal seal completely encapsulates the gasket, removing it from exposure to liquid or any external elements. As the only quick-connect style fitting approved by OPW and UL-listed for their piping systems, it is fully compatible with all fuel types, DEF, and standard OPW FlexWorks piping.


- Fiberglass DSE Top Adaptor: Building on the success of the popular DSE fiberglass dispenser sump, the system now features a new fiberglass top that can be bonded to the base. This bonded fiberglass-reinforced plastic (FRP) design creates a completely watertight seal with no hardware kits required.


- [71SO Segmented Overfill Valve](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=1304656408&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.opwglobal.com%2Fproducts%2Fus%2Fretail-fueling-products%2Funderground-storage-tank-equipment%2Foverfill-prevention-valves%2F71so-segmented-overfill-prevention-valve%3Futm_source%3Dpressrelease%26utm_medium%3Dpressrelease%26utm_campaign%3Dwpma_2026%26utm_content%3Dpressrelease&a=71SO+Segmented+Overfill+Valve) : Retaining the breakthrough two-stage positive shut-off mechanism of the original 71SO, this updated valve introduces a drop tube made of four 5-foot-long interlocking sections. This easily assembled, segmented design helps reduce the potential for shipping damage, overlength freight fees and frees up space in both distributor warehouse racks and service trucks. The compact packaging easily fits on a standard skid, or the box can be shipped via UPS for overnight emergency situations. The segments attach easily without messy glues or epoxies during on-site installation, allowing immediate installation after assembly without the standard 24-hour wait times of competing models.


**OPW Vehicle Wash Solutions (OPW VWS):**[OPW VWS](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=1030745892&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.opwvws.com%2F&a=OPW+VWS) , a leading single source provider for all vehicle wash needs, will be exhibiting a portfolio of integrated car wash solutions designed for convenience stores across its product brands, including:


- [WashCloud Portal by Innovative Control Systems® (ICS)](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=2394995233&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.icscarwashsystems.com%2Fwashcloud&a=WashCloud+Portal+by+Innovative+Control+Systems%C2%AE+(ICS)) : The newest digital platform from ICS brings all relevant customer, equipment, and site data, including number of washes, subscribers, LPR information, revenue per wash and churn rates, into one easy-to-read dashboard. WashCloud serves as a central data hub for the car wash, presenting all information in a straightforward way. The dashboard is accessible from anywhere, enabling operators to make informed, strategic decisions about marketing, promotions, memberships and on-site resource utilization.


- [ICS Auto Sentry MAX®](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=3249695747&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.icscarwashsystems.com%2Fauto-sentry-max&a=ICS+Auto+Sentry+MAX%C2%AE) : The next evolution in car wash point-of-sale, designed with a 32" interactive screen that supports customizable video content and new ways to display upgrades, memberships and offers. Auto Sentry MAX transforms the customer experience and simplifies decisions, helping operators increase club sales and maximize revenue.


- The OPW VWS portfolio also includes category-leading car wash systems, such as the[LaserWash360 Plus IBA](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=3778312617&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.opwvws.com%2Fproducts%2Fpdq-products%2Fcar-wash-equipment%2Flaserwash-360-plus.html&a=LaserWash360+Plus+IBA) from PDQ® , advanced payment technologies, car wash chemistry and protection from[Turtle Wax Pro®](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=203803739&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.turtlewaxpro.com%2F&a=Turtle+Wax+Pro%C2%AE) , customized marketing strategies, and dedicated support and resources designed for C-store growth.


**About Dover Food Retail:**


Dover Food Retail is the partner to customers seeking to create unique food experiences. Operating through our industry-leading brands, Anthony, Hillphoenix, Advansor, and The AMS Group, and headquartered in Conyers, Georgia, we can provide insight and a comprehensive portfolio of innovative solutions that enable our customers to sell more food profitably. Our ability to evolve with the ever-changing market demands is driven by our passion for understanding our customers' business and providing them with the best quality products and services they need to succeed today and in the future. Our focused, forward-thinking approach, combined with the strength of our brands, sets the stage for streamlined product development, a broader product portfolio, and cutting-edge technology, redefining what is possible for customers in the food retail value chain. The Dover Food Retail group of companies are subsidiaries of Dover Corporation. For more information, please visit[doverfoodretail.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=1586264542&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hillphoenix.com%2Fcompany%2Fdover-food-retail%2F&a=doverfoodretail.com) .


**About Dover Fueling Solutions:**


[Dover Fueling Solutions® (DFS)](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=1517935142&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.doverfuelingsolutions.com%2F&a=Dover+Fueling+Solutions%C2%AE%C2%A0(DFS)) is part of Dover Corporation and a leading provider of advanced energy dispensing equipment, electronic automation, point-of-sale and payment systems, automatic tank gauging and subscription solutions to fueling and convenience retail customers worldwide. Comprised of brands Wayne®, Tokheim®, OPW®, ClearView™, PetroVend®, ProGauge™, Fairbanks®, AvaLAN Networks™, LIQAL®, Bulloch Technologies®, and SiteIQ™, DFS is dedicated to offering a broad range of solutions that power vehicles, including conventional fuel and clean energy products that support gasoline, diesel, bio-diesel and ethanol as well as LNG, H2, LPG, CNG and EV chargers. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a strong global manufacturing and technology development presence, including facilities in Brazil, Canada, China, India, Italy, Poland, Belgium, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States. For more information about DFS, visit[www.doverfuelingsolutions.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=2844229086&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.doverfuelingsolutions.com%2F&a=www.doverfuelingsolutions.com) .


**About OPW Retail Fueling:**


[OPW Retail Fueling](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=448702277&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.opwglobal.com%2Fopw-retail-fueling&a=OPW+Retail+Fueling) is Fueled By Excellence through innovations designed to enhance safety, reliability, efficiency and business performance for the retail-fueling industry. Specifically, OPW Retail Fueling makes aboveground and underground fuel-handling products for both conventional, vapor-recovery and clean-energy applications in the retail and commercial fuel markets. OPW Retail Fueling is part of OPW, a leading equipment manufacturer in the retail-fueling, clean-energy, fluid-handling and vehicle wash industries. OPW has manufacturing operations in North America, Europe, Latin America and Asia Pacific, with sales offices around the world. OPW is part of Dover Corporation. To learn more about how OPW Retail Fueling is Fueled By Excellence in each of its markets, please visit[opwglobal.com/opw-retail-fueling](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=4092127139&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.opwglobal.com%2Fopw-retail-fueling&a=opwglobal.com%2Fopw-retail-fueling) .


**About OPW Vehicle Wash Solutions:**


OPW Vehicle Wash Solutions was formed in January 2019 and consists of[PDQ Manufacturing, Inc](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=3080457330&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.pdqinc.com%2F&a=PDQ+Manufacturing%2C+Inc) .,[Belanger, Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=2049202327&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.belangerinc.com%2F&a=Belanger%2C+Inc.) ,[Innovative Control Systems](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=3208036669&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.icscarwashsystems.com%2F&a=Innovative+Control+Systems) (ICS),[Kesseltronics](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=2494156499&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.kesseltronics.com&a=Kesseltronics) and[Transchem](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=2773808250&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.transchem.com%2F&a=Transchem) . PDQ is a preeminent provider of in-bay automatic wash systems and payment terminals, while Belanger is an innovative leader in soft-touch tunnel and in-bay automatic wash systems. ICS provides industry-leading car wash technology, like payment terminals, process controls and software management and automation systems, and Kesseltronics designs machine controls for successful tunnel wash operation. Transchem is a leading developer of environmentally sensitive vehicle wash chemicals and cleaning products. Together, they create a revolutionary single source for all vehicle wash needs. For more information on OPW Vehicle Wash Solutions, please visit[opwvws.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=358288883&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.opwvws.com&a=opwvws.com) .


**About Dover:**


Dover is a diversified global manufacturer and solutions provider with annual revenue of over $8 billion. We deliver innovative equipment and components, consumable supplies, aftermarket parts, software and digital solutions, and support services through five operating segments: Engineered Products, Clean Energy & Fueling, Imaging & Identification, Pumps & Process Solutions and Climate & Sustainability Technologies. Dover combines global scale with operational agility to lead the markets we serve. Recognized for our entrepreneurial approach for over 70 years, our team of approximately 24,000 employees takes an ownership mindset, collaborating with customers to redefine what's possible. Headquartered in Downers Grove, Illinois, Dover trades on the New York Stock Exchange under "DOV." Additional information is available at[dovercorporation.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786599-1&h=633436023&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dovercorporation.com%2F&a=dovercorporation.com) .
